scope: Synthetic 12-bit straight-alpha PQ/HLG HEVC source, native color/alpha preservation, actual Metal linear composition and swap, thumbnail and native window. Full objective remains incomplete.
producer: libheif 1.23.6/x265 lossless RGBA16 PNG -> 12-bit HEVC; authored CC0
independent_decoder: FFmpeg native HEVC decoder; stream 0 is primary RGB, stream 1 is auxiliary alpha
independent_alpha: All 6144 auxiliary 12-bit alpha codes match input 0,1024,2048,4095. Primary RGBA16 output has opaque alpha because FFmpeg does not composite HEIF auxiliary alpha; it is not falsely used as an RGBA oracle.
native_checks: Every normalized native RGB/alpha sample, retained straight RGB even under alpha zero, unchanged alpha after explicit PQ/HLG conversion; primary RGB math remains compared against independent Decimal/chromaticity references.
metal_checks: Six-source pressure/swap transport exact in native float bits and SDR/HDR frames. For each alpha file, 16 interior RGB/alpha controls are compared against linear foreground*alpha*2 + background*(1-alpha), within binary16 precision. All sampled control components finite; display alpha=1 throughout the frame.
thumbnail_checks: CLI/preload RAM cache hit and thumbnail route for both HDR alpha sources; all transparent top-quarter thumbnail pixels equal background RGBA8 36,36,36,255; managed credit zero after owners dropped.

native_window.observation: CUA screenshots show transparent top quarter and colored alpha steps after 32 minus keys; R reset redraws immediately. Test app quit with Cmd-Q; process absence verified.

limitations: Single tiny warm source ready time is not a performance benchmark.
Native screenshot and offscreen readback do not measure physical HDR nits/color.
Independent camera/proprietary HEIC producers, premultiplied alpha, sequences and other codecs remain open.
All 100 formats and real slow-disk/OS-wide pressure scope remain incomplete. NVIDIA deferred.
